description: exp_g_0018 - clone of exp103_singlestream_compression_manyheads with THREE changes: (1) embedding_dim E 384 -> 64; (2) inter-layer residual SUMMATION replaced by PURE CONCATENATION with NO residual -- each block reads the PREVIOUS block's output (y_l = block_l(y_{l-1}), y_0 = tok_emb), every y_l is stashed, and all 6 are concatenated at the end -> concat_dim = 6*64 = 384 -> LayerNorm(384) -> UNTIED Linear(384 -> 32768); (3) ASYMMETRIC head dims: q/k keep d_qk=64 (as exp103) while v drops to d_v=16, so attention scores come from 64-dim q.k but values are 16-dim and the attention output interior is H*d_v = 6*16 = 96 (was 384); out_proj maps 96 -> E=64. SDPA supports d_qk != d_v natively (output width follows v). The many-heads grouping is unchanged from exp103: 48 routing mini-heads summed in groups of 8 into 6 attention heads. LUT per-site nap/tph/inner_in unchanged. layer_combine='residual_sum' retained in code as a later ablation, NOT the run config. Shared lutorch NOT modified.
